use: Illustrated mech portraits for the MECH★POP browser hangar and HUD. The native portraits are renders of the separate articulated models.
art_direction: Chibi robot head and shoulders in three-quarter view. Crisp dark ink contours, flat cel shadows, sharp enamel highlights, a plain midtone backdrop and a silhouette readable at 90 pixels.

portraits.rivet: Squat traffic-orange salvage tug with a reinforced hardhat brim, hazard stripes, cyan worklight, bolted cheeks and a magnet fork against burnt ochre.
portraits.kite: Aerial courier with a turquoise teardrop helmet, white swept winglets with vermilion tips and mango-yellow optics against petrol teal.
portraits.rook: Ivory rook-tower helmet with three battlements, ultramarine visor, amber eyes and a slab shield with a cobalt stripe against slate blue.
portraits.coda: Mulberry percussion robot with bronze drumhead ear cups, an ivory tuning fork, amber optics and a flared bell against dark lilac.
